items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: He was on Stan Kenton’s band and Charlie Barnet, all the bands.

ctx.x: So Ronnie, tell me how many musicians were in your family?

Well my father, Artie. My brother Freddie, who was on every band in the world man. He left Utica when he was about 20. He was on Stan Kenton’s band and Charlie Barnet, all the bands. And that was in the band era you know. And he settled in New York and then he moved to Las Vegas later on. But my father was a musician, my father worked in the

Stanley Theater playing bass in the Stanley Theater Orchestra. Those were the days where they had stage shows and they might show a movie and they’d have a stage show or just stage shows. And my father loved that gig. He loved it. It was like the best gig he could get in Utica you know. I mean in that area at the time. And then it ended and he was destroyed when that ended, man. Then my uncles that were musicians, my uncle Jerry, my uncle Bob, he was a violinist, my uncle Tony was, he just gigged around, he sang…
